usage: The word 份 (fan6) is used as a measure word for portions or shares, commonly referring to food or document portions.
It can quantify an amount that is divided or shared among people or things.
份 typically comes after a number and before a noun, for example: '一份飯' (one portion of rice).
This measure word is often used in restaurants or when splitting items into parts.
份 can also indicate someone's share or assignment of tasks or goods.
